info.name: ModelServer General API
General
Computes structural assembly.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the entry (i.e. 1tqn).

params.name: name
params.description: Assembly name.

params.name: model_nums
params.description: A comma-separated list of model ids (i.e. 1,2). If set, only include atoms with the corresponding '_atom_site.pdbx_PDB_model_num' field.

params.name: encoding
params.description: Determines the output encoding (text based 'CIF' or binary 'BCIF'). Ligands can also be exported as 'SDF', 'MOL', or 'MOL2'.

params.name: copy_all_categories
params.description: If true, copy all categories from the input file.

params.name: data_source
params.description: Allows to control how the provided data source ID maps to input file (as specified by the server instance config).

params.name: transform
params.description: Transformation to apply to coordinates in '_atom_site'. Accepts a 4x4 transformation matrix, provided as array of 16 float values.

params.name: download
params.description: If true, browser will download text files.

params.name: filename
params.description: Controls the filename for downloaded files. Will force download if specified.

info.name: Returns a JSON response specifying if data is available and the maximum region that can be queried.

params.name: source
params.description: Specifies the data source (determined by the experiment method). Currently supported sources are: x-ray, em.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the entry. For x-ray, use PDB ID (i.e. 1cbs) and for em use EMDB id (i.e. emd-8116).

items.docs: Returns a JSON response specifying if data is available and the maximum region that can be queried.

info.name: Returns density data inside the specified box for the given entry. For X-ray data, returns 2Fo-Fc and Fo-Fc volumes in a single response.

params.name: source
params.description: Specifies the data source (determined by the experiment method). Currently supported sources are: x-ray, em.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the entry. For x-ray, use PDB ID (i.e. 1cbs) and for em use EMDB id (i.e. emd-8116).

params.name: bottomLeftCorner
params.description: Bottom left corner of the query region in Cartesian or fractional coordinates (determined by the `space` query parameter).

params.name: topRightCorner
params.description: Top right corner of the query region in Cartesian or fractional coordinates (determined by the `space` query parameter).

params.name: encoding
params.description: Determines if text based CIF or binary BinaryCIF encoding is used. An optional argument, default is BinaryCIF encoding.

params.name: detail
params.description: Determines the maximum number of voxels the query can return. Possible values are in the range from 0 (0.52M voxels) to 6 (25.17M voxels). Default value is 0. Note: different detail levels might lead to the same result.

params.name: space
params.description: Determines the coordinate space the query is in. Can be cartesian or fractional. An optional argument, default values is cartesian.

items.docs: Returns density data inside the specified box for the given entry. For X-ray data, returns 2Fo-Fc and Fo-Fc volumes in a single response.

info.name: Returns (downsampled) volume data for the entire "data cell". For X-ray data, returns unit cell of 2Fo-Fc and Fo-Fc volumes, for EM data returns everything.

params.name: source
params.description: Specifies the data source (determined by the experiment method). Currently supported sources are: x-ray, em.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the entry. For x-ray, use PDB ID (i.e. 1cbs) and for em use EMDB id (i.e. emd-8116).

params.name: encoding
params.description: Determines if text based CIF or binary BinaryCIF encoding is used. An optional argument, default is BinaryCIF encoding.

params.name: detail
params.description: Determines the maximum number of voxels the query can return. Possible values are in the range from 0 (0.52M voxels) to 6 (25.17M voxels). Default value is 0. Note: different detail levels might lead to the same result.

items.docs: Returns (downsampled) volume data for the entire "data cell". For X-ray data, returns unit cell of 2Fo-Fc and Fo-Fc volumes, for EM data returns everything.
